# FIG

> FIG is a restaurant deals app for Markham, Ontario, Canada. Restaurants post their own deals; diners find them on a map, claim one in a tap and show a rotating QR code at the counter. Free for diners. Free for restaurants to list, post deals and scan, with no commission on dine-in. FIG is paid by the optional FIG Premium ($50 a year: unlimited locations, deal announcements every 2 hours, area insights, menu from a photo) and 5% of the food on takeout orders diners pay for in the app.

## Facts
- Based in: Markham, Ontario
- Platforms: iPhone and Android
- Launch area: Markham first, expanding to Richmond Hill and Vaughan Mills
- Diners: free; no loyalty points, rewards or AI features
- Restaurants: free (listing, unlimited everyday and flash deals, scans, chats, dashboard); takeout orders paid in the app: FIG keeps 5% of the food before tax, and Stripe's card fee comes off the same payment; free insights (views, claims, diners who came in and came back); no ads
- How a deal works: claim (it stays good until the deal ends), show the QR code (refreshes every 5 minutes), pay the restaurant directly
- Takeout: with a deal that allows it, or at full price where the restaurant takes plain takeout orders; pay in the app and pick up at the counter; no delivery, and no fees for diners
- Privacy: restaurants never see a diner's phone number

- [About](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/about): the full story and FAQ

- [Takeout order math: what a restaurant keeps on a $12, $20, $40 or $60 order](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/takeout-order-math-what-you-keep): On FIG, takeout paid in the app costs 5% of the food plus Stripe's card fee. The $0.30 part of that fee is fixed, so small orders cost a bigger share. Here are the numbers on four order sizes, and what to do about them.
- [How restaurant deals work on FIG, from claim to counter](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/how-restaurant-deals-work): Everything that happens between seeing a deal and paying the bill: claiming, the Voucher tab, the code at the counter, takeout, what happens when a deal ends, and rating the visit.
- [How to run a slow-hour deal that makes money (with the math)](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/slow-hour-deal-math): A slow-hour deal makes money when it fills seats that would otherwise be empty and covers its food cost. Here's the arithmetic: contribution per plate, the worst case, the cap, and how to tell new diners from regulars who'd have come anyway.
- [% off, $ off or 2-for-1? Pricing a restaurant deal](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/deal-types-percent-dollar-2-for-1): The four kinds of restaurant deal, side by side: what each costs you, what it feels like to a diner, and when to use it. With worked examples on a $14 dish.
- [Set up your FIG menu and takeout in 15 minutes](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/set-up-fig-menu-takeout): A step-by-step guide for restaurant owners: your page, your menu, your first deal, and in-app takeout with your HST number and Stripe payouts, explained simply.
- [HST registration for small restaurants in Ontario: the $30,000 rule explained](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/hst-registration-small-restaurants-ontario): When a small Ontario restaurant has to register for HST, what changes when it does, and how HST works on deals and takeout. Plain-language, with the Canada Revenue Agency's own rules linked.
- [Eating out as a group: picking a place, deals and splitting the bill](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/group-dining-deals): How to get a group from 'where should we eat?' to a table: deciding fast, checking there's room, making deals work for everyone, and splitting the bill fairly, with the arithmetic.
- [How to read a restaurant's reviews on FIG](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/how-to-read-restaurant-reviews): Reviews on FIG come only from diners whose visit was scanned. Here's how ratings, likes and replies work, and how to read a restaurant's page to decide in a minute.
- [FIG is free for restaurants. Here's how we make money](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/how-fig-makes-money): Listing, deals, scans and chats are free on FIG, with no commission on dine-in. FIG is paid by the optional FIG Premium ($50 a year) and 5% of the food on takeout orders diners pay for in the app.
- [How to find the best restaurant deals in Markham](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/restaurant-deals-markham): A practical guide to eating out for less in Markham, Ontario: when restaurants post deals, where to look across the city, and how to use FIG to find and use them.
- [Delivery app commissions vs FIG: what restaurants keep](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/delivery-app-commissions-vs-fig): Delivery apps charge restaurants a percentage of every order. FIG charges nothing per dine-in diner and 5% of the food on in-app takeout. Here are the published Canadian rates and what a restaurant keeps from the same order.
- [7 ways to fill slow hours at your restaurant](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/fill-slow-hours-restaurant): Practical, low-cost ways for independent restaurants to bring in diners on quiet afternoons and weeknights, with the arithmetic to make sure a deal adds money instead of giving it away.
- [Student food deals in Markham: eating out on a budget](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/student-food-deals-markham): How high school and university students in Markham can eat out for less: when deals show up, how to set a real budget, how to decide as a group, and how FIG keeps it free.
- [What are flash deals, and how do they work on FIG?](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/flash-deals-explained): Flash deals are short, real-time restaurant deals posted during unexpected quiet spells. Here's how they work for diners and restaurants, how to catch them, and what happens to a claim when the timer ends.
- [Takeout with a deal, pick up, skip the delivery fees](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/takeout-without-delivery-fees): Some FIG deals let you order takeout from a Markham restaurant's menu and pick it up yourself, with no delivery or service fees. Here's how it works, what it costs, and what happens if you're late.
- [Why we built FIG](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/why-we-built-fig): Markham is full of great independent restaurants, and most of them run on thin margins. FIG is a deals app built around that: free for diners, free for restaurants to post deals, and no cut of a dine-in bill.
